title: Poman Lo：中国策略如何兼顾增长与排放？
speaker: Poman Lo

segments.en: Again, it has to be a collective movement. China is going to be central to this. And we just had the minister for the environment and ecology just speak in the next room. What stood out to you
segments.zh: 这必须是一场集体行动，中国将是核心。环境与生态部长刚在隔壁发言。您觉得中国战略中什么最突出？

segments.en: in terms of China's strategy here? China's strategy has always been to drive economic growth without
segments.zh: 中国的战略始终是在推动经济增长的同时，不让排放失控。

segments.en: letting emissions go out of hand. And I think the main philosophy is, again, this theme of collective
segments.zh: 我认为核心理念正是这个主题：集体繁荣、共同富裕。

segments.en: flourishing, common prosperity. So, while technology advances, obviously, are transforming the world, we also have to make sure that no one is left behind, and that these solutions actually are beneficial
segments.zh: 因此，科技进步显然在改变世界，但我们也必须确保不让任何人掉队，并让这些解决方案真正惠及

segments.en: to the people, to businesses, and it has to be good for our future as humanity.
segments.zh: 人民和企业，并且必须有利于人类共同的未来。
